title: Objective Auto-run controls UI hardening — canonical status card, defaults-from-terms, idempotent retries
description: Owner-facing Auto-run controls on /app/objectives/:id (ObjectiveDetail.tsx). Control state now comes from the canonical GET /auto-policy polled every 5s while the page is visible (each tick aborts the prior request — no stale overwrite, no overlapping reads); cockpit snapshot is only the loading fallback. Card shows policy state+effective+reasons, limits (ceo calls/missions/retries/budget cap USD/window), truthful driver readiness (driver_ready + driver_missing), halt record, and per-transition action buttons mirrored from the backend TRANSITIONS table — EXPIRED offers 'Re-arm policy (new limits)' (configure only, never a silent re-enable), HALTED offers reset_halt, REVOKED offers nothing. Configure dialog prefills editable defaults derived from the objective's own terms (deadline→expires_at when a valid future instant, budget ceiling→USD cap, 20 calls/5 missions); Configure and Enable remain separate owner actions — no auto-enable. Idempotency hardening: new logical operations use crypto.randomUUID(); the key is bound to action+objective+limits signature so an ambiguous-failure retry replays the SAME key while changed semantics mint a fresh operation; CAS 409 refetches canonical state. New /app api seam autoPolicyStatusApp carries noAuthPrompt and AbortSignal. Zero backend/service/scheduler/schema changes. e2e: objectives.spec.ts 26/26 pass incl. 6 new focused tests (card, defaults, same-key retry, 409 refetch, EXPIRED/REVOKED labels, 5s poll); the pre-existing 'policy HALT' double-click flake documented in P15.9-B5.4 remains a known baseline (passes isolated).
